title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Triple Mango Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Triple Mango offers a deep, juicy Mango flavour that’s layered, rich and tropical. By blending multiple Mango profiles — from syrupy to sun-ripened and bright — this flavour captures the fruit’s full character in a vape that’s bold, smooth and unmistakably Mango from start to finish. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, designed for use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Combined, they deliver up to 6000 puffs (based on personal usage) of consistent vapour and high-impact flavour. Dual mesh coil technology ensures an authentic, full-flavoured vape, while the automatic refill system and leak-resistant design make maintenance quick and easy. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod provides rapid nicotine relief and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit tailored for MTL vaping. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to keep the mango magic going.
